title: Chapter 269: The Three Powerful Clans Of Bear, Wolf And Eagle
content:
Chapter 269: The Three Powerful Clans Of Bear, Wolf And Eagle

The Goblins know some of the details of the Zerg. When it comes to building a city, the Zerg and the Goblins are really worlds apart and cannot be compared at all.

Wu Qing did not reject the goodwill of the Goblins. He originally planned to rebuild the 66th city. Now that the Goblins are helping, it can be regarded as a major issue.

The construction of ground cities is of certain help to the long-term development of the Zerg.

After discussing the city building, Gong Yi, on behalf of the Goblins, made a solemn invitation to Wu Qing, inviting Wu Qing to visit the Goblins' clan land and formally meet with the Goblins' senior officials to discuss matters related to deepening strategic cooperation between the two clans.

Wu Qing thought about it and agreed to the invitation of the Goblins.

Gong Yi brought the Goblins' invitation intention. If Wu Qing agreed, there would be further arrangements in the future. When the relevant matters were arranged properly, the Goblins would formally send an invitation letter to the Zerg.

After Wu Qing and Gong Yi finished their business, they began to chat while waiting for the gifts from both sides to be handed over.

At this moment, a large group of flying creatures flew from the horizon in the direction of the main city!

The Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Dragons in charge of vigilance immediately took action and made preparations for air defense.

Wu Qing had seen the appearance of the people coming through the Zerg host. They were a group of peculiar races with eagle heads, human bodies and wings on their backs. They were wearing sophisticated sky blue armor and carrying bows, arrows, short swords and other weapons. They were elite flying soldiers at a glance.

"Lord, these should be people from the Eagle Clan!"

Gong Yi took a look and knew that the people coming were the Eagle Clan, one of the three powerful tribes on the public battlefield in the southern theater.

The Eagle Clan came with an elite force of 10,000 people this time. They flew very fast and flew over the sky of the 66th city in the blink of an eye.

The elite troops of the Eagle Clan came roaring, not taking the threats of the Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Dragons to heart at all, and seemed very high-profile.

The elite force of the Eagle tribe, numbering 10,000 people, demonstrated their superb flying skills, from high-speed flight to suspension in mid-air, all in one go.

Several Eagle tribe members left the group and slowly flew towards Wu Qing and Gong Yi, relying on their flying advantage to give people a feeling of being superior.

"The Eagle tribe is arrogant, Lord, don't take it to heart!"

"They also have this attitude when dealing with our tribe!"

Gong Yi explained to Wu Qing, who was silent beside him.

Although the Eagle tribe did not obtain the status of a large tribe, its strength is not much different from that of an ordinary large tribe. The number of large tribes is limited, and many races in the local camp are stuck with this quota.

Like the Eagle tribe, Bear tribe and Wolf tribe on the public battlefield of the Southern Theater, this is the case.

Moreover, many races were originally large tribes, but they lost their status as large tribes for some reasons, and their strength is not worse than that of large tribes.

The Goblin tribe does not want the Zerg to have conflicts with these powerful tribes. Many races are not only strong in themselves, but also have the support of other large tribes behind them, and the relationship is very complicated.

The Zerg had just arrived, so it was inevitable that they didn't understand the interests involved.

The Eagles who flew down did not land completely, but gently waved their wings and hovered in the air, continuing to maintain a condescending attitude.

The Eagle in the middle, who had very sharp eyes, ignored Gong Yi on the side and asked an embarrassing question directly.

"Are you the Zerg lord? As a human, why don't you return to serve the human race?"

His eagle eyes were like knives, staring at Wu Qing, as if looking at prey.

This was a very rude provocation!

Wu Qing was a little helpless in the face of this kind of provocation. He wanted to make more friends, and races like the Goblins and Nagas were very good.

But the other party didn't give him a chance, so he could only force him to conquer!

He also knew that the local camp was a hodgepodge and very complicated. It was unrealistic to want to make friends with all races. Pulling some and beating some was the best strategy.

Wu Qing put away his gentle smile, and the aura that had been suppressed on his body was instantly released, and a terrible aura that was very inconsistent with the five-star strength of the insect man clone burst out!

The Eagle tribe members who were hovering in the air suddenly lost control and fell from the air. They lost their ability to think, and only felt that life and death were between Wu Qing's thoughts!

The tens of thousands of Eagle tribe elite troops flying in the air, Wu Qing's aura was not aimed at them, they also felt Wu Qing's terrible aura, and involuntarily grabbed the bow and arrow!

One of the powerful energy fluctuations locked Wu Qing, as if to break the momentum with force and break Wu Qing's aura.

Wu Qing's aura was cultivated in the previous world. Now with the improvement of strength, it is slowly recovering. It is not something that an Eagle tribe strongman who relies on brute force can break.

But if someone threatens with lethal force, if you don't fight back, it will seem that the Zerg is easy to bully.

The power of the Queen of Zerg instantly descended on the five-star Zerg hosts around Wu Qing, like a terrifying spiritual force, pressing on the tens of thousands of elite Eagle troops in the crudest way!

All the elite Eagle troops, including the Eagle warrior, fell down like a kite with a broken string, and fell heavily to the ground, losing their combat power!

A large number of Zerg puppies suddenly emerged from the ground and were about to pounce on the elite Eagle troops that fell to the ground!

"Lord! It's not appropriate to start a war!"

Gong Yi's own strength is not weak, Wu Qing did not target him, so he was not affected much, and he quickly spoke out to stop it.

The last thing the goblins want to see is internal fighting in the local camp.

"Hahaha...! Look, those proud eagle cubs have become chickens now!"

A loud laugh reverberated in all directions, and before anyone arrived, the sound had already arrived!

Wu Qing put away his momentum and returned to his gentle state.

The Insect Queen's mental power has also restrained, and she no longer targets the elite troops of the Eagle Clan.

A large number of Zerg puppies that had just emerged from the ground re-entered the ground.

Except for the elite troops of the Eagle Tribe who were so arrogant just now, and now they are all forced to fall to the ground, nothing else seems to have changed.

"Rumble...!"

Outside the 66th city, two cavalry units came flying towards them.

One group is a bear tribe member riding a giant bear, with a bear head and body, tall and strong!

One group is a wolf tribesman riding a giant wolf, with a wolf head and body, cold and fierce!

The person who just shouted loudly was a giant bear knight running at the front.

"Lord, this is the Bear Clan and the Wolf Clan. The Bear Clan has a more honest character, but also has a bad temper. Relatively speaking, it is easier to get along with them."

"The overall strength of the wolf clan should be the strongest among the three clans. They had the most hope of gaining the status of a big clan."

Seeing Wu Qing return to normal, Gong Yi introduced Wu Qing in a low voice.

The Eagle Clan is arrogant, while the Bear Clan is honest and irritable. Gong Yi didn't say what happened to the Wolf Clan, but he gave the most important reminder. The Wolf Clan is the strongest, and now the Zerg Clan is about to seize the big clan spot. The one with the most thoughts on his mind should be the Wolf Clan. .

Therefore, the ones that the Zerg should be most careful about are the wolves.

"Haha! I'm just telling you not to run so fast. With your bad habits, you might get beaten!"

"Look, I was right!"

Following the loud voices, the two cavalry troops arrived near the place where the elite troops of the Eagle Tribe fell.

The Bear Clan cavalry pointed at the Eagle Clan's elite troops who had stood up and rearranged their formation, while the Wolf Clan cavalry just glanced at them and quietly lined up to stand by.

The speaking bear knight and a capable wolf knight rode towards Wu Qing on their mounts.

When Wu Qing and Gong Yi approached, he quickly got off his mount, saluted Wu Qing and Gong Yi, and said goodbye: "Xiong San of the Bear Clan pays homage to the lord! I have met the steward!"

"Wolf Clan Langlin meets the lord! Meets the steward!"

The Xiong clan member who calls himself Xiong San looks carefree, but he is still very considerate in his actions and has a good sense of proportion.

Lang Lin, a member of the wolf clan whose temperament is somewhat similar to that of Bai Yan, behaves in a flawless and orderly manner.

Wu Qing and Gong Yi responded according to the etiquette of this world.

"Yingwen! Come here quickly! You must have said something inappropriate again, which prompted the lord to beat you up!"

"The clan members will be implicated by you and suffer the consequences!"

Xiong San turned around and shouted to the Eagle Clan member who asked Wu Qing why he didn't serve the Human Clan.

After seeing Wu Qing's unusual aura and the powerful strength of the Zerg tribe, the Ying tribe member named Yingwen still had a straight face, but he became much more honest and did not dare to look directly at Wu Qing anymore.

As the representative of the goblin tribe, Gong Yi stepped in to calm down the atmosphere, and then everyone sat down together and talked about business.

The three tribes, Bear Tribe, Wolf Tribe, and Eagle Tribe, received the news that the Zerg Tribe had defeated the Tianwai Human Race, and immediately sent important people here for the purpose of the Tianwai Human Race.

On this public battlefield in the southern war zone, with all the major races suppressing it, direct conflict between the various races in this camp is definitely not possible. At best, it will be some small actions in secret.

The real competition of strength lies in killing enemies on the battlefield.

Although the strength of the Tianwai Human Clan invested in the public battlefield in the southern war zone is only the power of one force within the Tianwai Human Clan, it can still overwhelm the three tribes of Bear, Wolf, and Eagle.

The three tribes can only confront the Tianwai Human Race in their respective spheres of influence. They cannot take care of areas like District 108. From time to time, each major tribe needs to personally take action to ensure that the main city is not lost.

It can be said that the three tribes were quite passive when facing the outsider tribe.

The original idea of the three clans was that under the attack of a super clan like the Tianwai Human Clan, they would protect their territory and perform their best. As long as they performed well, they might be able to obtain the status of a clan.

Now that the Zerg race is a strong competitor, the three tribes have more thoughts on their minds, and they have the idea of counterattacking the outer human race.

This time the three tribes sent people over to communicate with the Zerg and see what the Zerg thought.

"Our clan will try our best to attract the troops of the Tianwai Human Race in the 108th District. You can counterattack in a timely manner according to the changes in the battlefield situation!"

Wu Qing told the three tribes about the idea of temporarily establishing a foothold in an area and attracting the Tianwai Human Race to fight. With the hatred of the Tianwai Human Race towards the Zerg, he was not afraid that they would not take the initiative to attack.
